output.brief:
What is going on: the drop is concentrated where two things happened together. Dock Street and Westgate moved to RotaWeave and lost their coordinators on 1 May. Staff stopped booking regulars into their usual weekly slots, and 88% of the April regulars who lost their slot twice are now inactive. Millbrook kept its coordinator and stayed flat on the app; Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app and stayed flat. The background-check renewal hit all four sites equally, so it does not explain the gap, and the Commonplate opening (16 June) came after the decline started in May. Confidence is moderate-to-good, not certain: the booking-loss link rests on one reconciliation compiled by a manager, and the survey link may run in reverse.
Next steps: do not cancel RotaWeave yet. Do not suspend the renewal or strip inactive volunteers from the figures. Immediately restore weekly bookings at Dock Street and Westgate, using an admin seat and phone calls to lapsed regulars, and review in 60 days. Also restore coordinator-level oversight at those sites.
